title: Ultimate Coffee Duo
description: Not sure which espresso blend you would like most? We’ve made it easier for you to decide by bundling our top-selling blends at a cheeky discounted price. Veloce (250g) is our flagship blend, the one you’ll find in most cafes serving Atomic. It’s crafted to make a smooth, complex espresso with notes of dark chocolate, cinnamon and stone fruit. and a balanced flat white. Supremo (250g) is for the ‘strong’ coffee lovers – full-bodied, rich in deep chocolate undertones, and elevated by a confectionary sweetness that becomes caramel-like with milk. Our notes for this blend are cacao nibs, marshmallow and clove . Bundle these two classics together and save $6.00!

title: Veloce
description: Veloce is our flagship blend - a rich, sweet and complex espresso that pours like velvet. Roasted delicately so notes of bittersweet chocolate, cinnamon spice and ripe stone fruit cut through. Delicious with or without milk, it's true espresso - the aficionados’ choice.

title: Supremo
description: Called Supremo for a reason, it is a blend with remarkable full-bodied sweetness, great depth of flavour and complexity, and lingering clove and cinnamon spice notes. As an espresso, Supremo has strong dark cocoa flavours, a creamy, smooth body and a soft sweet finish.
